Definition: probably akin to the base of G5530 through the idea of handling; the body (properly, its surface or skin):--body.
BiblicalUsage: The body here is the skin itself, and handkerchiefs taken from Paul's body carry healing to the sick. The word is as plain as it gets — the surface of a person — and God works through it.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God is not embarrassed by the body, and He can use the most ordinary things, even cloth that has touched a servant, to heal.
